title: Normal operators and spectral resolution
objectives: Prove that self-adjoint operators have orthonormal eigenbases
Relate eigenvectors of a normal operator and its adjoint
Prove Schur's theorem and the spectral theorem
Compute spectral resolutions and polynomials of operators
prerequisites: Adjoints (Chapter 23), unitary and self-adjoint operators (Chapter 24), eigenvalues and projections.
source_scope: The captions of the three recordings (positions 56 to 58) were read in full. The multiplication-operator example comes from the first; the running symmetric matrix, the rotation-dilation matrix, laboratory and exercises are original.
